metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows easy exercises that may end in satisfying pop, crack, or release in the lower back and hip.

They're also great for relieving general muscle tightness and improving pain-free range of motion.

All of these exercises work differently. To get the best results, go through them all and use what works best.

Watch now and self pop your lower back and hip!
